text: Figure 5.40: Leverage of DiagnosticEnvironmentalCondition on the AUTOSAR adaptive platform [TPS_MANI_01372] Properties of data obtained from the application software ⌈The properties of the data obtained from the application software can be configured in the context of DiagnosticEnvDataElementCondition, namely by means of the aggregation of SwDataDefProps in the role swDataDefProps.⌋ [constr_10114] Existence of attributes of DiagnosticEnvDataElementCondi- tion if the reference in the role pPortPrototype exists Imposition time: IT_DiagDes ⌈If the reference in the role DiagnosticEnvDataElementCondition.pPortPro- totype exists, then the aggregations in the roles compareValue, process, and swDataDefProps shall exist.⌋ Class DiagnosticEnvironmentalCondition Note The meta-class DiagnosticEnvironmentalCondition formalizes the idea of a condition which is evaluated during runtime of the ECU by looking at "environmental" states (e.g. one such condition is that the vehicle is not driving, i.e. vehicle speed == 0).
